grades.quote: The `BoundedBuffer` code in Figure 4.17 takes a very aggressive approach to notifying waiting threads: at the end of any operation all waiting threads are woken using `notifyAll` . This is a very safe approach; if the `BoundedBuffer` ’s state was changed in a way of interest to any thread, that thread will be sure to notice. Other threads that don’t care can simply go back to waiting.
